notes.title: The Tower of Worth 2.0 -Contract and Reward-
notes.content:
[h1]Finally, The Tower of Worth 2.0 Update is coming![/h1]

The Tower of Worth 2.0 has various improvement that make game more interesting!

[list]
[*] Contract and Reward
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34799200/03f35d0d5013b91d25a78542181e7d1bf2f4d08e.gif[/img]
Now You can make contract that provide various challenges in game by invest your worth.
If you success in contract, you can get powerful reward that have special effect helping climb the tower.
But Beware! Failed contract is worthless and no reward.

[list]
[*] Improved Ego System
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34799200/f6838763683ed758257dc7ed6e9f6ff8214d84e9.gif[/img]
Now Ego unlock condition become easier and Intuitive.
And you can find which trait of Ego was experienced in Detailed information screen. Experience all ego and make the most effective Ego to climb the Tower!

[list]
[*] New Skills
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34799200/67e045bac8e4271ef21568d60f6000da9d918cfa.gif[/img]
Now all weapons contain one basic attack and four special skills!
But you can’t start with all special skills.
Select favorite three skills in four special skills!

[list]
[*] Improved Battle
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34799200/2b9c5de0aacc596182e95268f1d91ae14286cd28.gif[/img]
Battle become more complicated and exciting! If you fight well, enemies become more strong and tough.
But don’t worry! Eventually all enemies in The Tower need to follow Rule of The Tower. Understand Rules and react wisely. No one can stop you.


I'm very happy to finally release the new update. Interestingly, it's been about two years since we started developing The Tower of Worth with this update. The Tower of Worth was my first Steam launch game and there were a lot of deficiencies. This update is not just about adding new features, it's about fixing a variety of deficiencies and making the game even more exciting.

Thank you!

notes.title: The Tower of Worth - upcoming new update plan!
notes.content:
The Tower of Worth - upcoming new update plan!


Hellow, long time no see!
The Tower of Worth is already released in early May.
But sadly Game's reaction is not so good. Maybe just abandoning game could be good choice.
[b]Nevertheless[/b], It's really small, but there are someone who enjoy and playing this game, and 
I still think The Tower of Worth have possibility.
 So I decide to enhance and rework The Tower of Worth.

After release The Tower of Worth, I kept consider about what will need to make game more interesting and exciting. As a result, I made the plan to solve problem of The Tower of Worth and improve key features.

[b]New Update will release at the End of October![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/8ff500a0efb9c423a42b31b17081085d25c17848.png[/img]

[h1]Contract[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/03f35d0d5013b91d25a78542181e7d1bf2f4d08e.gif[/img]

As the player progresses the stage, he can put his worth into various contracts. and By completing the contract, he will be able to earn more rewards and worth.

Some contracts are easy to solve but some is very difficult and dangerous.
Of course, the more difficult the contract is, the more rewards and worth it offers.

	
[h1]Reward[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/facae555015a9722ed6c4bcbff6865eeeb749e7d.gif[/img]

By completing contract or some other ways, player can get rewards.
Rewards have various special abilities that help game play.
	
	
	
One of the problem in The Tower of Worth was boring repeating game play in early stage. In one stage, the only thing player have to do is just defeating enemies and go up forward and game changing factor ,like weapon or ego, is hard to give variety in early stage.
Contract ,new content of this update, will suggest various handicap and condition to game play and if success contract, it provide various rewards.
I expect this new content will give refresh and newly experience to game play.
	
	
[h1]Ego Improvement[/h1]
The Tower of Worth is EgoChanging roguelike game. Player experience and understand challenger's changing ego and need to use ego trait efficiently to defeats tower's danger.
This part is one of the most important feature of The Tower of Worth, Origin of the game.
So for more confidently and smoothly ego changing game play, there will be various improvements.
	
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/f6838763683ed758257dc7ed6e9f6ff8214d84e9.gif[/img]

First of all, in this update, now new interface that player can search each possibility of ego will be add.
Player will always be able to search unlocked ego's trait in ego information screen and 
check which trait is unlockable.
	
And next, I'll change some ego's unlock condition and changing factor for ego's character and purpose.
	
As a last, I'll add some more trait and fix some status for detail ego changing.
	
	
[h1]Stage Improvement[/h1]
Continue to previous update, I'll improve additional stage gameplay.
New enemies, attack pattern, various enemies combination etc.
	
	
And more some minor change and bug fix will coming to next update.
	
	
I'll announce about this update plan one more time at September.
Thank you for having interest in The Tower of Worth!

notes.title: 1.1.01 Update - Worth of Dead -
notes.content:
[b]The Tower of Worth's new Update is coming![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/c507b09e6cfadc0a26f9feb887911c5d785d4766.png[/img]

In this Update, I've add Some Systems that make normal stage's battle more meaningful and interesting.

[list]
[*] Normal Enemies system change.
[*] Execute system change and Status EXP add.
[*] Room clear action add.
[*] Challenger provoke system add.
[*] Alteration of Ego UI improve.
[/list]



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/5ad21ade9c248c07f684781b23d477e96cd7f635.gif[/img]

[h1][b]-Normal Enemies AI, Damaging System change, Number of Enemies Increase.[/b][/h1]
In previous version, Only 2,3 enemies spawned in one room and if number of enemies increase, battle was become too difficult. A small number of enemies make game boring and lack of exciting.
With this update, Now most of enemies take stun by most of attack and react slowly against player. This allow me to deploy a larger number of enemies from various combinations.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/6fe3eb5edcb2754afe8473bcd789f8ae53d5f9b9.gif[/img]

[h1][b]-Change of Execute System[/b][/h1]
In previous version, Execution had features of HP restore, temporary buff and Spawn new enemy when time passed. But execute all enemies in short time was not easy work and new enemies spawned from it was not so meaningful and just annoying.
With this update, no more additional enemy from time pass and corpse do not disappear by time.
And by executing enemies, you can get Status EXP.


[h1][b]-Status EXP[/b][/h1]
In previous version, player's status increasing is only enable from end point of floor. This system made hard to feel player's challenger is growing.
Status EXP getting from execution is another system of status increasing. Now player's challenger can get level up from executing.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/993cfee9a986b8600ba051f3aa2789e87be10d00.gif[/img]

[h1][b]-Room clear action[/b][/h1]
Number of enemies increase and you can get EXP from execute enemies. this make boring and tired task of executing all remaining corpse after room clear. So I add room clear action that you can execute all remaining enemies or sympathies dying enemies.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/56cef7c3c9d0996c40cf0f91ec424c2db0b9beb6.gif[/img]

[h1][b]-Provoke Challenger[/b][/h1]
In previous version, If other challenger didn't want to fight with player, it was hard to block its choice. Now, player can provoke non-hostile challenger and engage fight.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/a0dbfce3d2c7fbb93ea4dfb975b68b331d1b1467.gif[/img]

[h1][b]-Alteration of Ego UI improve.[/b][/h1]
I've add some system and plan to add more system. but The Tower of Worth's most important feature is Ego Changing. In this update, Add Alteration of Ego Description UI. It explain player to what is Alteration of Ego and what player can do. And If player persist Ego, persist effect remain after Alteration of Ego.

notes.title: 1.02 Update - Skill and Special Ability-
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/3aaedb1104d73e6d979809a6e98f57dfe89a240f.png[/img]

[h1][b]-Skill Description[/b][/h1]
Now you can see a simple description and specific damage, stamina using, cool time of all skill you have.
And also If you Improve your skill, you can check what kind of additional effect obtained.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/7e9e85b01ba979eb44a680f101c14d14d940ff30.gif[/img]

[h1][b]-Fix Skill Improve[/b][/h1]
Previous Skill Improve effect is just simple damage up except some special skills.
Now, Most of Skills have its own special effect or other parameter changing added.



[h1][b]-Special Ability Description[/b][/h1]
You can get special ability when you execute Boss class enemies. But in previous version, There are no description about special ability. Now you can see detailed description about special ability you got.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/5455fa0e41fc39343c35c5bc3833513ce81787c4.gif[/img]

Thank you for feedback about The Tower of Worth!
The Tower of Worth still need more improvement! 
[i]I'll always welcoming new feedback![/i]

Thank you and enjoy The Tower of Worth! : )

notes.title: - 1.01 Update - balance and bug fix
notes.content:
Recently I recognized the Tower of Worth is too Hard!

It's not my intend and so I modify some content.


[b]- some enemy's hp decreased[/b]

even first stage, some enemies have too many hp(although it's strong enemy)
so I slightly down enemy's hp.

[b]- vivid stamina low effect[/b]

make stamina low effect more easy to notice and vivid.

[b]- boss damage buff decrease[/b]

originally when boss's hp become low, his attack power increased.
now still his attack power increase but not too high.


Thank you and enjoy the Tower of Worth!

notes.title: The Tower of Worth is released!
notes.content:
Finally The Tower of Worth is released on steam!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34799200/844829875e87c363d294be61a0b1588dc9ecf791.png[/img]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
It's been a long time!ːsteamhappyː The Tower of Worth's Full-scale development began in December 2017.
(maybe more long if I add initial game design time!)

The Tower of Worth is my first game to release. There have been several developments, but they've always been interrupted.ːsteamfacepalmː

When I first started developing it, I never imagined that I'd be able to release a game like this.
For the first time, I've post article, upload video, register game on steam And I got feedback from someone who was interested in my game!

Nevertheless Studio is a one-man developer. Making a game alone was lonely and hard. [b]Nevertheless[/b], I was able to come all the way here without giving up thanks to people who were interested in and watching on The Tower of Worth!

Thank you all from the bottom of my heart!

Please take a lot of interest on The Tower of Worth!
